new_render_policy: Matplotlib/seaborn exact requested serif whitegrid talk theme; PDF/PNG dpi=300.
parent_preview_policy: Byte-identical copies of original PDF/PNG/NPZ/metadata; original previews have 300 dpi PNGs.

selection_policy.CIFAR_severity_policy: Predetermined middle severity 3; not selected by model outcomes.
selection_policy.architecture_policy: Use Swin saved frontend tensors only if every displayed array and scale exactly equals ViT; otherwise retain both.
selection_policy.fit_distribution_policy: Fixed ten-image clean-training diagnostic only, not full-partition distributions; fitted mean/std table is full training partition.
selection_policy.samples: All ten original class-balanced fixed sample IDs, two groups of five, all native channels.
selection_policy.scope: No new model evaluation, predictions, normalization fits or input preprocessing. Stored arrays only.
selection_policy.unchanged_raw_reference: Dense unmodified raw p0 cases remain in the full source catalog; compact raw p0 explicitly shows natural-zero removal.
